settings.heading:
A bed that becomes yours,
and stays that way.
settings.lede: You cannot know how a mattress feels in four minutes. So the feel is decided after a year, not before, and the part that softens renews for twenty five years.

settings.heading: Pocket springs, individually housed
settings.text: Each spring moves on its own, so one person turning over does not move the other. It is the part that carries the twenty five year guarantee.

settings.heading: A comfort layer that comes out
settings.text: The top ten centimetres are what soften. Ours unzip and lift away, so the bed is renewed rather than replaced.

settings.heading: Made after you order it
settings.text: Nothing is built before someone wants it. No warehouse, no stock to clear.

settings.heading: How it is built
settings.lede: Three decisions that determine whether a mattress is still good in twenty years.

settings.label: Core
settings.text: Pocket springs, individually housed. Twenty five year guarantee on the core.

settings.label: Comfort layer
settings.text: Unzips and lifts off. Two feels. You do not choose a firmness. You turn it over.

settings.label: Comfort layer, later
settings.text: [layer] when it eventually softens. The core stays.

settings.label: Sizes
settings.text: Single through Emperor 200 x 200cm, including European King 160 x 200cm.

settings.label: Made
settings.text: To order. Nothing is held in a warehouse.

settings.heading: Our specification
settings.promise_body: If the feel is not right, we send the layer that takes you there, and you keep it, with our compliments. Worth [layer]. If that still does not settle it, we collect the mattress and refund you in full.

settings.heading: Built to be kept
settings.lede: A pocket sprung core lasts decades. The ten centimetres on top do not.
settings.body:
The part that softens is the top. The springs underneath are still doing their job.

Ours comes apart. When the comfort layer eventually softens, it unzips and a new one goes on. The core stays where it is, and so does the bed you chose.

settings.heading: You do not choose the feel. You discover it.
settings.text: Sleep on it for a year. Tell us how it should feel. We adjust it until it is.

settings.heading: It arrives finished.
settings.text: Concierged. Room of your choice. Unrolled onto your bed. The old one leaves with it.

settings.heading: It stays right for twenty five years.
settings.text: The part that softens renews. The part that lasts, lasts.

settings.heading:
A bed that becomes yours,
and stays that way.
Concierge unpacking
settings.text: Concierged. Room of your choice. Unboxed, unrolled, positioned. The packaging leaves with it. So does the old one.

settings.heading: Old mattress removal and recycling
settings.text: Taken away on the same visit. Nothing in the hall, nothing to arrange.

settings.heading: Nothing left behind
settings.text: Carton, plastic, wrap. All of it leaves with it.

settings.heading:
It arrives compressed.
We do not leave it that way.
settings.lede: Roll packing gets it up the stairs. It is not how it should be left.

settings.heading: Choose your size
settings.lede: Every size is made to order with the same 35cm construction and the same removable comfort layer.
